references.text: Beth-shur is mentioned as one of the cities that Rehoboam fortified in Judah.
Beth-shur is mentioned in connection with the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls under Nehemiah.
Gedor is mentioned in Judah's genealogy as a city where descendants of Judah settled.
Gedor is mentioned again in the genealogy, referring to Jered as the father of Gedor.
Gedor is mentioned as the home of some of David's warriors.
